items.item_text: Master's degree or Ph.D. in sociology, public policy, statistics, data science, environmental social science, science & technology studies, or a related or a related discipline and/or equivalent experience/training.
Applied research experience related to building energy systems, HVAC, indoor air quality, load flexibility, building electrification, or adjacent clean energy technology deployment.

Familiarity with UI/UX and usability research methods, including testing of consumer-facing energy technologies. Knowledge of building-energy technologies (e.g., heat pumps, advanced controls, mechanical ventilation systems), codes and standards, utility programs, and California or federal clean-energy policy landscape. Experience cultivating long-term stakeholder relationships across industry, government, and community-based organizations.
Experience with strategic communications, including website content, newsletters, and social media for research dissemination.
Track record of peer-reviewed publications or academic/industry presentations.
